song.lyrics:
[V1] . G Bm G How priceless is your steadfast love, O Lord . A D A Far more than life itself . D G Bm G In the shadow of your wings shall all who seek . A G D Find refuge and help
[C1] . D G A Bm For in You is the Fountain of Life . G D A G D A In your Light we see Light . D G A Bm For in You is the Fountain of Life . G D A G D In your Light do we see Light
[V2] . G Bm Through the abundance of your steadfast Love . G A D A We come into Your Holy place . D G Bm G In the fear of You, we worship at Your throne . A G D Of Mercy and Grace
[V3] . G Bm G We feast on the abundance of your house . A D A D G Bm As on the richest food from the river of delights . G A G D We drink our fill of all that is good
song.title: In Your Light We See Light
